task.description: Design and add test specifications and tests required to verify OBS-04 end-to-end. Cover backend timeline contract and edge cases (instance not found 404, deterministic ascending ordering, API-06 pagination cursor behavior, archived-event inclusion, actor display-name fallback, canceled-instance complete history) and frontend timeline rendering/data handling behavior introduced in step-02b. Produce traceable test artifacts and update/add tests in the appropriate test layers. Ensure test design aligns with implemented backend/frontend artifacts and requirement text.
acceptance_criteria: OBS-04 acceptance criteria are fully covered by concrete test cases with traceability
Backend and frontend test additions/updates are committed in appropriate locations
Test artifacts clearly map requirement clauses to executable tests
Any uncovered risk is explicitly documented in issues

result.summary: Added OBS-04 requirement-traceable test artifacts across backend and frontend layers: new test spec, backend integration coverage for timeline contract and edge cases (404 missing instance, deterministic ascending ordering, API-06 cursor continuation, archived-event inclusion, actor fallback order, cancelled-instance full history), and expanded frontend timeline utility coverage for rendering/data handling helpers used by Instance Detail timeline tab.

issues.description: Frontend OBS-04 timeline tab does not yet have a browser-level E2E test exercising real UI->API->DB flow; current frontend OBS-04 coverage is utility-level (formatting and merge behavior).

result.next_action: Route to TEST-RUNNER (WF-02 Step 4) with explicit verification of backend OBS-04 integration suite and follow-up frontend E2E gap assessment.
